name: bus-shelter
description: A broad bench beneath a flat canopy with a side support.
useCase: Identify a covered bus waiting area in a stop or street map.
misuse: Use bench for seating without a shelter, or bus for the vehicle.

16.reason: A solid backrest keeps the small bench readable beneath the canopy; the full seat and both legs remain.

24.reason: The outlined backrest, wide seat, supports and canopy retain clear gaps in the complete shelter.
